decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line saying the legacy `/ingester/flush_shutdown` handler was removed [ev-a1ca6a9f17f1]. It does not say what happens to callers, whether something replaces it, or that `--ingester.flush-on-shutdown` has anything to do with it. That leaves the proposed remediation unsupported. setting-ignored also looks like the wrong kind, because an HTTP endpoint is not a configured value. Deciding the kind and severity needs the PR #10655 description or the 3.0 upgrade guide, showing what callers of the endpoint get and what replaces it.
